invariants.rationale: The getPrefHeight method accesses style.usually ProgressBar's style must be non-null.
At least one of the background or knob drawables must be non-null for getMinHeight().
The knob's minimum height should be non-negative if knob is not null.
The background drawable's minimum height should be non-negative if it exists.
Preferred height should not be negative, as it is the max of two nonnegative heights.
